reason: Parent raised a specific consistency concern about R001 Arial input text. Reviewer rechecked only the original three declared CSS artifacts and common brand facts, plus existing bound review evidence. No new captures, model trials, source instructions, or variant mappings were used.
interpretation: The existing brand-and-facts check includes supplied explicit brand values. The original review enforced radiusPx=12 on the membership panel and form controls. The same treatment requires the specified Georgia text font on those controls, without an unprovided Arial exception. The primary/secondary scope of the brand fields is not spelled out element by element; this ambiguity is disclosed rather than silently resolving font loosely and radius strictly. Ordinary serif fallback faces and font fallback for decorative symbol glyphs are not equivalent to deliberately choosing an unrelated text face.
scopeAmbiguity: A brief that explicitly permitted a dominant-brand interpretation with secondary text fonts and smaller control radii could support different brand check outcomes. No such exception is supplied here. This correction retains the original strict exact-brand fidelity interpretation; it adds no new required check or rubric dimension.
